content.short: vBlocks offers a Gallery Builder for Cardano NFTs while the Open-World Beta is scheduled for Q3
content.description:
We provide an interactive 3D galleries builder which allow users to link their wallet and display their NFT collection in 3D showrooms. We provide a unique link for each gallery that can be shared freely within the community for anyone to see the NFTs you own and the story behind it!

We are also currently building an art-oriented open world metaverse where each land (vBlock) owner will own a space on the map. Each vBlock owner will be able to fully design his own space and visit others.
